Answer: C
Reason: The CT images demonstrate the classic "crazy-paving" pattern of pulmonary alveolar proteinosis (PAP), characterized by bilateral ground-glass opacities with superimposed interlobular septal thickening. This pattern typically shows a perihilar or central distribution with relatively sharp demarcation between the affected and normal lung parenchyma, matching the description in option C.
